# Awesome GPT Image GIFs

Community collection of publicly gathered GPT Image 2.6 (ChatGPT Images 2.6 / gpt-image-2.6-sunburst / gpt-image-2.6-flare) original-author cases. Independent, not an OpenAI product. The current public inventory is catalogued in full; this is not a claim of exhaustive web coverage.

Primary pages:
- https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/ — community case master table
- https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/#gifs — real GIFs only (source-hosted default; local seeds are not the main list)
- https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/game.html — game sequences with verification labels
- https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/ideas.html — appendix playbooks / adaptations
- https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/popular.html — popular-GIF restages, not 2.6 works

Canonical data:
- docs/data/community-cases.json — primary inventory
- docs/data/gallery.json — real GIFs only
- docs/data/ideas.json — playbook appendix
- docs/data/media-manifest.json — media, rights, exclusions
- playbooks/community-cases.md — readable master table

Coverage (Beijing 2026-11-06): X author-claim 25 + web GIFs 12 + in-repo Luffy/Krouxzz 2 + game author-claim 4 = 43 main rows. Pending 12. Official verified 2.6 game outputs: 0. Unwatched X MP4s. Link-only when license unknown.
